positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description: I built a time-saving web app debugging console for Google engineers to investigate user-contributed Street View imagery which has failed to upload. This web app consolidated information from many disjointed steps that engineers previously followed to debug. I also met with engineers from various teams to decide which technologies to use, and subsequently wrote a design document for visualizing the imagery, which was reviewed by my team. Features of the tool include: searching by different IDs, with pattern matching to infer the ID type; displaying data about the imagery fetched from storage via an RPC; visualizing the GPS track for the imagery using the Maps JS API; advancing through the imagery frame-by-frame.

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description: In collaboration with another intern, I replaced a set of scroll-intensive dropdowns used in an internal ChromeOS tool with a simple, custom search bar feature in which users can type in any combination of search attributes and values. My personal responsibilities included: parsing the search string into an intermediate data model using Java and JavaCC; creating the basic user interface with Angular, including adding autocomplete support; creating a wrapper to tie the backend together, and protocol buffers and actions to tie the frontend in, leveraging Guice throughout.

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description: I created a personal portfolio as a starter project, using Google App Engine, Java, Javascript, HTML, and CSS, which included an interactive comments section and a geomap of vegan restaurants. I also designed, implemented, and deployed a scheduling web application, SchedulR, to help students plan their next term, in conjunction with 2 other interns for a capstone project. My SchedulR responsibilities included integrating the Google Calendar API using Java, for users to quickly save their preferred schedule, and creating the course input form using ReactJS, with usability in mind (example: includes expandable input for entering multiple sections of the same course).

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: During my internship, I used InDesign to help write and design Electro Scan Inc.'s Water and Sewer Chronicles Issue 10 Newsletter, which they send out across the country each year. I got to attend two industry conferences and gained a comprehensive understanding of the company’s focused electrode leak location technology - which scans water and sewer pipes for leaks.

positions.title: Summer Staff
positions.description: I worked as a summer lifeguard for the YMCA and learned greater responsibility due to the important nature of the work, gained experience working with children teaching swim lessons, and got the opportunity to help my community.
